definitions.explanation: The administrative and ritual duties involved in running a Shinto shrine. Includes managing ceremonies, maintaining shrine grounds, handling visitors, and conducting daily rituals.

examples.japanese: {社務|しゃむ}を{執|と}り{行|おこな}う。
お{守|まも}りは{社務|しゃむ}{所|しょ}で{購入|こうにゅう}できます。
examples.english: Charms can be purchased at the shrine office.

examples.japanese: {宮司|ぐうじ}は{長年|ながねん}にわたって{社務|しゃむ}に{携|たずさ}わり、{地域|ちいき}の{祭|まつ}りの{運営|うんえい}にも{力|ちから}を{注|そそ}いできた。
examples.english: The head priest has been involved in shrine affairs for many years and has also put effort into managing the local festivals.

notes:
Refers to the various duties required to operate and maintain a Shinto shrine, encompassing both administrative tasks and religious ceremonies. Most commonly encountered by visitors in the compound {社務所|しゃむしょ} (shrine office), where visitors can purchase charms, receive blessings, and make inquiries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社務|しゃむ}{所|しょ}: shrine office (the most common use of this word)
- {社務|しゃむ}を{執|と}る: perform shrine duties
- {社務|しゃむ}{日誌|にっし}: shrine duty log

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {神事|しんじ}: Shinto ritual or ceremony (focuses on the religious aspect)
- {寺務|じむ}: temple affairs (the Buddhist equivalent)
- {祭事|さいじ}: festival affairs; ceremonial duties
